matching_method: greedy Euclidean nearest-neighbor matching on jointly standardized covariates; five controls per case; hardest case first; without replacement; no caliper
repeat_observation_rule: retain the lowest-JAM-chi2 row per MaNGA galaxy
common_support_exclusions: complete matching and outcome fields, nonnegative quality flag, and positive Re; no additional common-support trimming was imposed; all 62 eligible cases were matched
bootstrap_unit: 62 complete matched case sets, each retaining its five-control mean
gate_failures: MaNGA velocity/dispersion MAPS are absent from the repository.

secondary_warning: fdm_Re is inferred under a JAM/NFW model and is not a direct observable or a validation test of modified gravity.
